clue.text: Rigorous following detective in locality

clue.text: Dreadful chore, irons for African native perhaps

clue.text: Floor covering in vehicle particularly liked

a pet is a favourite, someone particularly liked

explanation.surface: A rug in a car that its owner is fond of.

clue.text: Female bishop, Rosemary, say?

clue.text: Nonsense to overlook metallic sound in combat area

clue.text: Manuel, perhaps, returning to remove water at resort

clue.text: Reportedly cure despicable person

clue.text: Dressing in robes I annoy a matron, upset

the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

clue.text: Pro English players joining monarch, he predicts

the cast is the set of players in a show
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

clue.text: Don't notice so much without blemish

free of any mark or stain

well means fine, in good health

clue.text: Father, Roman Catholic, seen by the Spanish area of land?

el is the Spanish for the

clue.text: Two firms working in comfortable place

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
on means working, functioning

clue.text: Black Sea region almost the best: I'm invited in

almost means the last letter of the word for the best is dropped

I'm without the apostrophe

clue.text: New listener close by

clue.text: Pitcher used by Crewe railway

clue.text: Container is returning with 50% of load

clue.text: List of events revised and clear
